enumeration.method: Independent bold-span heading enumeration and visual comparison of all seven complete theorem statements.

checks: Seven complete main-text Theorems1–7, independently enumerated by bold PDF spans, including the two-page T3. All finite thresholds, correction terms, primed constants, the exact step-size maximum and T5’s in-particular clause are retained.

Twenty-one original source entries preserve Bernoulli and graphon sampling, off-diagonal loss, scalar/matrix polynomial classes, general and homogeneous SBM classes, iid-label prior, full randomized Algorithm1, the exact Holder norm/class, co-membership, sparse probability matrices and rectangular Gaussian biclustering definitions. Eight auxiliary passages preserve source context separately.

Independent reconstruction confirms29 direct uses and43 related connections. Fixed-matrix minimax risks do not import a proof prior or random latent-position distribution. T4 imports its smooth graphon class and arbitrary latent law without requiring a homogeneous SBM. Rectangular Gaussian risk has no Bernoulli or graph-loss dependency.

T3 imports the full algorithm, its independent auxiliary randomness and theorem-specific tuning, without T2’s low-SNR premise or an extra degree-D condition. T5 targets pairwise co-membership rather than numeric labels. T7 uses the shared min(k1,k2) label range and all-entry rectangular loss.

Twelve notes preserve diagonal conventions, singular SNR endpoints, label nonuniqueness, the printed sketch dimension, iteration/degree accounting, algorithm probability and parameter scope, primed-constant text-layer errors, the integer Holder convention, rectangular label typos, Gaussian-noise independence and the distinction between low-degree results and runtime conjectures.

All21 entries have natural-language source terms, original labels/kinds and literal selectors. Every one of the43 theorem connections has a source-specific explanation and an independently reconstructed same-paper path.

All six content JSON files reproduce byte for byte from retained per-paper scripts. Seven scripts include frozen-hash source review, formula checks, dependency reconstruction and schema validation; rerunning extraction does not itself perform a new source review.

source_notes.note: Graphon and co-membership losses sum only i<j and divide by binomial(n,2); rectangular loss sums every entry and divides by n1*n2. The source defines Mf_ij=f(xi_i,xi_j) while the sampling model sets diagonal zero; the distinction does not affect off-diagonal loss.

T1,T6 take a supremum over fixed parameter matrices; T2,T5 and T7 average over their stated priors and observation noise. T4 additionally supremizes over arbitrary iid latent-position distributions. Do not introduce balanced labels or a uniform latent law into these scopes.

The model permits q=0 and p=1, but the finite SNR ratios use q(1−p) in the denominator. Nontrivial ratio statements require a positive denominator; the source gives no boundary division convention. T5’s target additionally requires p>q.

The source asserts unique zM even though simultaneous label permutations leave M unchanged. The off-diagonal co-membership matrix ZM is uniquely determined when p>q. The displayed relation for Mij is interpreted off diagonal, as required by the model’s zero diagonal.

Algorithm1 prints B∈R^(p×r), where p is a connectivity probability. Matrix multiplication by the n×n transformed adjacency requires B∈R^(n×r). Preserve the printed source and flag this dimensional typo separately.

T3 sets integer iteration counts t1=t2=C-prime log n without a rounding convention. The printed total degree bound2 t1 t2 misses terms from the displayed recurrence: the generic degree upper bound is 2(t1+1)t2+1 in A,Lambda,B and 2t1t2+1 in A alone with the auxiliary randomness fixed. Both remain O(log²n).

T3 denotes probability by the signal-prior symbol PSBM although its event also involves sampled adjacency and independent Lambda,B. Record the natural joint experiment and this notation ambiguity. The surrounding prose says any p,q∈[0,1], while the referenced prior was introduced under q<p; no unproved scope extension is made.

The PDF’s text layer misreads C-prime,C-double-prime and c-prime as C1,C2 and c1. The census follows the visually printed primes in T3 and T6, preserving the different roles of tuning constants and output constants.

The printed Holder norm uses floor(gamma) derivatives and exponent gamma−floor(gamma), including exponent0 when gamma is an integer. It works on the lower triangle; boundary derivative interpretation is implicit. Do not replace it with another standard Holder convention or silently assert additional boundary extensions.

The parameter-space displays use Q_(zi,zj) while defining separate vectors z1,z2. The prior then prints both vectors as length n, but explicitly indexes rows by n1 and columns by n2. Preserve these typographical inconsistencies and resolve the intended row/column indices separately.

Both row and column labels in PBC are uniform over min(k1,k2), not separately over k1 and k2. The additive observation model states iid standard Gaussian noise; independence from the random signal is the usual intended model but is not separately explicit in that sentence.

The theorems prove lower bounds for degree-constrained polynomial estimators. Equivalence to all algorithms of a given runtime is a conjectural interpretation; the source itself discusses failures of low-degree predictions for certain other problems. No universal runtime lower bound is recorded as proved.

ambient_resolution.T1: Integers n,k,D with 2≤k≤sqrt(n), D≥1. Real entrywise polynomial estimates of degree≤D; fixed M in the full symmetric k-class zero-diagonal model; expectation over conditionally independent Bernoulli edges. No class balance or homogeneous prior is assumed.
ambient_resolution.T2: Assortative homogeneous SBM prior with iid uniform k labels, q
ambient_resolution.T3: The full randomized Algorithm1 under the specified homogeneous SBM experiment, with auxiliary diagonal Bernoulli(p) and independent Gaussian sketch. r=2k, positive sufficiently large primed tuning constants, log-scale iteration counts, the exact max in eta, and n≥Ck log³n. Bound holds on the stated high-probability event; no low-SNR premise from T2 is inherited. Dimension, rounding and probability-notation ambiguities are recorded.
ambient_resolution.T4: Gamma>0.5, L>0, polynomial degree D≥1, the printed bounded smooth-graphon class, and every latent distribution Pxi on [0,1]. Expectation integrates iid latent positions and conditional Bernoulli graph. Retain exponent (2gamma+1)/(2gamma+2), not the USVT exponent 2gamma/(2gamma+1).
ambient_resolution.T5: Same prior/conditional Bernoulli experiment as T2, but target ZM is the zero-diagonal co-membership matrix and loss is off-diagonal pairwise squared discrepancy. Exact general threshold, 1/k−1/k²−3/n bound and in-particular k≤sqrt(n) clause. Numeric labels are identifiable only up to permutations.
ambient_resolution.T6: Sparse SBM class with 0<rho<1 from preceding definition, 2≤k≤sqrt(n), rho≥c k²/n for some small fixed c∈(0,1), and D≥1. Fixed-matrix worst-case risk under Bernoulli observations; c-prime is a separate lower-bound constant. Preserve the source’s reversed argument order ell(M,Mhat), harmless for the squared discrepancy.
ambient_resolution.T7: Positive integer n1,n2,k1,k2 and D≥1, 0<r<1, real signal amplitude lambda under the displayed squared threshold. Prior labels on both sides are uniform on the shared min(k1,k2) classes; rectangular iid unit Gaussian observation model. Loss includes all n1*n2 entries. Keep both correction terms and max/min dimensions; no square-matrix, symmetry or Bernoulli assumptions.

source_claim_references.scope: Full randomized estimator recurrence and auxiliary randomness; T3 supplies tuning and sample size.
Bayes-to-minimax reduction; does not import the homogeneous prior or finite SNR condition into T1.
Smooth graphon lower-bound construction; no homogeneous SBM condition becomes a statement premise and no appendix body is read.
Rearrangement of the graphon lower bound; T5 retains its own explicit SNR condition and co-membership loss.
Gaussian-noise low-degree tools are proof machinery; appendix body excluded.

review_limits: Registered arXiv:2308.15728v4 dated 12 Aug 2024, pinned by SHA-256. No substitution with another paper version.
Main-text proofs end on PDF page27 before References. All appendix bodies are excluded; proof-only constructions and propositions are not promoted into theorem statement dependencies.
Source and schema validation do not certify proofs or resolve the explicitly recorded source ambiguities.
